Clear contents or start fresh

Choose the reset level that matches what you are about to upload. This prevents old marks or student records from being mixed with a new dataset.

Start Completely New

Use this before loading a different course, subject, location dataset, or a fully fresh project.

  • Clears course and syllabus data
  • Clears CO–PO and assessment mapping
  • Clears students, marks and report evidence

New Student List / Cohort

Use when the course setup and mapping are correct, but you want a fresh student population and fresh marks.

  • Keeps syllabus, CO–PO and assessment mapping
  • Clears all students and marks
  • Clears normalisation and report-cycle evidence

Fresh Marks Only

Use when course setup, mapping and the student list are already correct and only marks need to be reloaded.

  • Keeps students and all mappings
  • Clears raw and working marks
  • Clears normalisation history
Safe reset: these actions clear only the current working dataset. Saved project files and projects stored in the browser are not deleted. Replacing a student list without clearing intentionally retains marks for matching Student IDs; use one of the options above when you need truly fresh data.
